title: Baked `fetched_utc` derives from cache-file mtimes, breaking the byte-identical determinism contract
evidence:
Determinism contract: same cached raw response -> byte-identical
dublin.json. ... times.append(os.stat(p).st_mtime) ... "fetched_utc": _fetch_time(cache_dir),
detail: Rule 2: 'same query/bbox → same dublin.json'. fetched_utc reads filesystem mtimes, so byte-identical raw responses re-cached at a different time/machine bake a different asset; --verify passes only while mtimes stay untouched.
recommended_fix: Derive fetched_utc from the cached raw responses' osm3s timestamp_base (content-pinned), or drop the field; re-run --verify.

title: ODbL 'credits note' (rule 3) exists nowhere outside the asset
location: data/maps/dublin.json (attribution/license fields); N/A for the missing note
evidence: attribution = © OpenStreetMap contributors / license = ODbL 1.0 — © OpenStreetMap contributors; this asset is a derived snapshot of live OSM data. / $ grep -rln "OpenStreetMap" . -> ./tools/osm_extract.py, ./data/maps/dublin.json (no other matches; 'credit' matches only balance.json's unrelated 'spawn-credit')
detail: Rule 3: 'ODbL attribution inside the asset + a credits note.' In-asset attribution is present, but the second deliverable — a human-facing credits note (README/docs) — was never added anywhere in the repo.
recommended_fix: Add an OSM credits note (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0) to README.md or docs/.

title: Board size map.* restated as Python constants instead of read from balance.json (ODN-5)
evidence:
# Board size (data/balance.json map.*): the camera fits this into 1280x720.
BOARD_W_TILES = 40
BOARD_H_TILES = 30
TILE_PX = 26 / (data/balance.json:75 "map": { — /map = {'w_tiles': 40, 'h_tiles': 30, 'tile_px': 26})
detail: Spec: 'fitted to the board size (map.* in balance.json)'; project rule: 'balance numbers live in data/*.json, never restated in code (ODN-5)'. Values match today; any balance.json change silently desyncs every future bake.
recommended_fix: Load w_tiles/h_tiles/tile_px from data/balance.json at bake time in osm_extract.py and render_dublin_preview.py.

title: 'Offline-rerunnable' bake depends on an uncommitted .osm-cache
evidence: +.osm-cache/ +__pycache__/ / `.osm-cache/<query-hash>.json`; cache-first, so re-bakes are offline). / ls .osm-cache -> 'no .osm-cache in worktree' / spike commit stat: '13 files changed, 807 insertions(+)' — no cache files committed
detail: Spec: '(committed, deterministic, offline-rerunnable)'. The raw extract cache is gitignored and absent from the commit; a fresh clone must re-fetch live, drifted OSM, so byte-identity with the committed asset is unverifiable beyond raw_sha256.
recommended_fix: Commit the pinned raw cache (or archive it) beside the asset, or document that reproduction requires the original baker's cache.

title: Previews use Open Sans, not the briefing's named 'IBM Plex' — documented deviation, intent satisfied
evidence: and the game font (assets/fonts/open_sans_regular.ttf — the HUD font the render layer loads; the briefing's "IBM Plex" was stale, the game ships Open Sans). / app/render/view.odin:1294: FONT_ASSET :: "assets/fonts/open_sans_regular.ttf"
detail: Spec: 'the preview must use the game's palette/typography (IBM Plex)'. The game's actual font is Open Sans; the preview loads the game's real font and palette.json tokens, so the honest-review intent ('so the review is honest') is met.
recommended_fix: None required; optionally correct the stale IBM Plex reference in the briefing.

title: Existing-file edits (.gitignore, .memlog.md) exceed the 'new files only' rule
detail: Rule 1: 'new files only (tools/osm_extract.py, data/maps/dublin.json, preview renders)'. The diff also edits two existing files and adds field-notes. Acceptance 'Zero diff to existing sim/render/goldens' still holds.
recommended_fix: Accept as repo process convention (memlog/gitignore accompany every job), or split such edits into a separate housekeeping commit.
